bars.name: Bamboo Beach Bar
bars.category: Beach Bar, Sunset Bar, Chill-Out Bar
bars.cardDescription: Bamboo Beach Bar is a laid-back, beachfront bar at Mae Haad Pier, offering panoramic views of the sunset. It features tropical bamboo decor, sand-floor seating and a relaxed reggae vibe, popular with divers and...
bars.about: Bamboo Beach Bar is a laid-back, beachfront bar at Mae Haad Pier, offering panoramic views of the sunset. It features tropical bamboo decor, sand-floor seating and a relaxed reggae vibe, popular with divers and long-stay travelers. The atmosphere is lively yet easy-going, often with local live music in the evenings. It’s an ideal spot to unwind before or after ferry travel
bars.recommendation: Choose Bamboo Beach Bar when you are looking for spectacular west-facing sunset views and its chilled, barefoot vibe. Guests often linger over drinks on the sand as night falls.
bars.localTip: Best visited around 17:30–18:30 for sunset. It fills up at sunset; come early to grab beach seating. No reservations needed. Parking for scooters is on adjacent streets. Children are welcome (though final hours are more party). The usual crowd is a mix of 20–40s, mostly divers and long-term visitors. Remember it’s relaxed: noise stays moderate. There’s no indoor space, so visit early monsoon season (Oct–Dec) when weather allows. You can leave backpacks at the bar while touring downtown. Wind-down music and view make it a perfect pre- or post-dive stop. (Disclaimers: Wind can be strong at night; some travelers report overzealous street hawkers outside.)
bars.bestKnownFor: Spectacular west-facing sunset views and its chilled, barefoot vibe. Guests often linger over drinks on the sand as night falls
bars.signatureDrink: Tropical rum cocktails (e.g. rum mango mixers, Mai Tais); cocktails are the specialty, and ice-cold beers. The bar is noted for its “expertly crafted cocktails”
bars.signatureFood: None (no kitchen; currently no food is served)
bars.atmosphere: Casual and friendly island lounge with beach seating and bamboo stools. Music is mellow reggae/acoustic by day, live bands or DJs by night
bars.musicStyle: Reggae, acoustic and island tunes; live bands or occasional DJ sets after dark
bars.dancing: Limited (a few patrons may dance on the sand)
bars.familyFriendly: Yes (quiet vibe, not a party environment)
bars.happyHour: Not publicly advertised; check in person (often sunset drink deals mentioned by visitors)
bars.payment: Cash accepted; credit cards usually OK for drinks
nearby: Mae Haad Pier (Songserm pier) and ferry terminal
bars.accessibility: Ground-level beachfront; a few steps from street
bars.parking: Limited scooter parking along Songserm Pier Road
bars.practicalInfo: No food service, so eat beforehand. Can store luggage for free if you’re a House Koh Tao guest waiting for a ferry. No Wi-Fi (digital detox)

bars.name: Fishbowl Beach Bar
bars.category: Beach Bar, Live Music Venue, DJ Club
bars.cardDescription: Fishbowl Beach Bar is one of Koh Tao’s oldest and most famous beachfront bars. Located on Sairee Beach, it boasts arguably the best sunset view on the island. The seating includes low tables and Thai cushion beds on...
bars.about: Fishbowl Beach Bar is one of Koh Tao’s oldest and most famous beachfront bars. Located on Sairee Beach, it boasts arguably the best sunset view on the island. The seating includes low tables and Thai cushion beds on the sand. It features nightly entertainment: local live bands start around 20:00 and DJs from 22:30. Late evening, it transforms into a high-energy nightclub on the beach
bars.recommendation: Choose Fishbowl Beach Bar when you are looking for vibrant party atmosphere with all-night music, beach games (beer pong, limbo) and fire shows. Its “legendary” sunset and drink promotions (e.g. 190฿ for two cocktails at sunset) draw crowds daily.
bars.localTip: Arrive by 18:00 to grab a front-row cushion for sunset and happy hour deals. The bar fills up by 19:00; crowds peak around 20:30 (live band) and again at DJ start (~22:30). No reservations – come early for group seating. Where to park: scooters along beach road. Children should enjoy early evening (up to 20:00). The crowd is mainly 20s-30s travellers. Beware: drink refills slow during peak; tipping may help speed service. Beer pong tournaments and limbo happen weekly. Seasonal: open all year (indoor bar under roof if raining). No Wi-Fi (connect with people!)
bars.bestKnownFor: Vibrant party atmosphere with all-night music, beach games (beer pong, limbo) and fire shows. Its “legendary” sunset and drink promotions (e.g. 190฿ for two cocktails at sunset) draw crowds daily
bars.signatureDrink: Passion fruit mojito (a guest favorite). Also offer SangSom whiskey buckets
bars.signatureFood: Casual bar snacks (pizza slices, wings, satay – from onsite kitchen). The chicken wings are popular per visitor reviews
bars.atmosphere: Lively and social, beach-party vibe. By day it’s relaxed; by night it’s energetic with dancing. Decorated with beach lights and casual tables
bars.musicStyle: Live bands (pop/rock covers) 20:00–22:30, then DJ dance music into late night. Often plays open-format and party hits
bars.fireShow: Yes (regular fire performances on the sand)
bars.seating: Outdoor (sand-floor seating with low tables and cushions)
bars.happyHour: Yes (e.g. 190 ฿ for 2 cocktails or buckets around sunset)
bars.accessibility: Wide beach entry. Sand and steps to seating; not wheelchair friendly
bars.practicalInfo: For best sunset view, ask staff for a beach table by 18:00. Beer pong tables (BYOBucket play) are first-come. Expect crowds from 20:00 onward (especially Fri–Sun). Safety: watch belongings when dancing. Taxi/cab out from Sairee after closing (last ferries) is tricky – arrange pick-up in advance if needed

bars.name: Choppers Sports Bar
bars.category: Sports Bar, Pub, Live Music Venue
bars.cardDescription: Choppers Sports Bar is a two-story Aussie-style sports pub in central Sairee. It’s known for its extensive drink menu (with import beers and craft options) and a full Western pub-grub menu (burgers, fish & chips,...
bars.about: Choppers Sports Bar is a two-story Aussie-style sports pub in central Sairee. It’s known for its extensive drink menu (with import beers and craft options) and a full Western pub-grub menu (burgers, fish & chips, etc.). Choppers broadcasts global sports on large screens, and hosts live bands and karaoke several nights a week. It also organizes the Koh Tao Pub Crawl (Mon/Wed/Fri/Sun)
bars.recommendation: Choose Choppers Sports Bar when you are looking for live sports broadcasts (all major events) and its lively pub crawl events. It’s the island’s “premier sports bar” with a friendly, communal vibe.
bars.localTip: Best for watching sports (especially European games). Busy on game nights (footbal, F1, UFC). No need to reserve for small groups; large bookings advised for event nights. No seaside view, but has draft beers (Tiger, Stella) and craft imports. Food is made to order – good quality. Staff speak fluent English. Dress casual; no beachwear needed. The usual crowd is 20s–40s, a mix of expats and adventure travelers. Late-night taxi (from Sairee) is infrequent; plan return by scooter or walk (30 min). Good spot for trivia nights and pub quizzes (Friday nights)
bars.bestKnownFor: Live sports broadcasts (all major events) and its lively pub crawl events. It’s the island’s “premier sports bar” with a friendly, communal vibe
bars.signatureDrink: “Jugo” beer buckets (house cocktail jugs) and craft cocktails. Mojitos and Espresso Martinis are popular
bars.signatureFood: Gourmet pub classics – try the Grubhouse smashed burger or chicken Parmigiana. The menu emphasizes Western comfort food (burgers, tacos, bangers & mash)
bars.atmosphere: Upbeat, sociable pub environment with large indoor and outdoor seating. Friendly staff, often expats. Sports memorabilia décor
bars.musicStyle: Live rock cover bands (local/visiting) 2–3 times weekly. DJs or quiz nights occasionally
bars.beachfront: No (on main street, short walk to beach)
bars.groups: Yes (popular with sports fans and groups)
bars.soloTravellers: Yes (easy to join others at tables)
bars.hours: Daily 11:00–02:00 (live sports on through the night as needed)
bars.happyHour: Yes (e.g. Tue–Thu 17:00–19:00, 2-for-1 cocktails; 50฿ tacos at 17:30 daily)
nearby: adjacent to 7-Eleven and SBS Bank ATM
bars.accessibility: Street level entry. Interior has one step up to kitchen
bars.parking: Scooter parking in front (short-term) or alleyways
bars.practicalInfo: Live sports on all day via multiple big screens. Check “What’s On” via website or FB for events. Pub Crawl meeting point: Monday, Wednesday, Friday, Sunday evenings. Quiet early afternoons; crowds build during live games or evening bands. Can get crowded on quiz/trivia nights. Air-conditioned indoors is a respite on hot days

bars.name: Maya Beach Club
bars.cardDescription: Maya Beach Club is a popular day-time beach club on Sairee’s south stretch. Open noon–21:00, it features beanbag and hammock lounging on the sand under umbrellas. From mid-afternoon it turns into a beach party with...
bars.about: Maya Beach Club is a popular day-time beach club on Sairee’s south stretch. Open noon–21:00, it features beanbag and hammock lounging on the sand under umbrellas. From mid-afternoon it turns into a beach party with live DJs and cocktails. It has an on-site kitchen (Idjang’s Kitchen) serving Thai and Western dishes
bars.recommendation: Choose Maya Beach Club when you are looking for all-day beach party vibe with resident DJs and a swim-up pool bar. It’s a “go-to” spot for Friday sunset beach parties and happy hour cocktails.
bars.localTip: Arrive before 17:00 to catch happy hour and secure pool or beach seating. The crowd is 20s-30s (holiday vibe). Mondays are usually quiet, Fridays/Saturdays pack with party goers. Reservations not needed unless a big group. They close at 21:00 sharp; plan dinner elsewhere afterwards. Power-cuts are rare, but have torch app just in case after sunset. Parking is better at Sairee Village and walk down (narrow beach access road). No outside drinks allowed
bars.bestKnownFor: All-day beach party vibe with resident DJs and a swim-up pool bar. It’s a “go-to” spot for Friday sunset beach parties and happy hour cocktails
bars.signatureDrink: *Juicy Moose* cocktail (highlight of their specials) and classic Mojitos
bars.signatureFood: Thai-Western fusion: items like chicken satay, burgers, smoothies from Idjang’s kitchen
bars.atmosphere: Vibrant and youthful. Daytime is chill; late afternoon becomes festive. Lots of beanbags, big beach mats and even inflatable pools
bars.musicStyle: International DJs (electronic lounge) 17:00 onward. Before that, ambient beats
bars.payment: Cash only (credit rarely accepted at beach bars)
nearby: On Sairee Beach south (near Goodtime Hostel). Next to Banana Bar Ao Sane path
bars.accessibility: Beach entry (scooter road, then steps to sand)
bars.parking: Park on Sairee Road; walk down path to beach
bars.practicalInfo: Drop in any afternoon to lounge in pool or sunbeds. The pool is saltwater and open to all. Sunscreen recommended (no shade late day). The DJ lineup changes weekly. Book a beach sofa if visiting with a large group (via FB)

bars.name: Serve Chilled Roof Garden
bars.cardDescription: Serve Chilled Roof Garden is a hidden rooftop bar in Mae Haad, offering 180° ocean views. Perched up Main Street, it’s styled as a garden with fairy lights, comfortable seating and an open-air deck. The atmosphere is...
bars.about: Serve Chilled Roof Garden is a hidden rooftop bar in Mae Haad, offering 180° ocean views. Perched up Main Street, it’s styled as a garden with fairy lights, comfortable seating and an open-air deck. The atmosphere is calm and welcoming, with a mix of travelers enjoying sunsets and cocktails. Cocktails and international beers are featured, often with fresh local ingredients
bars.recommendation: Choose Serve Chilled Roof Garden when you are looking for panoramic sunset vistas and expertly-crafted cocktails. It’s a favorite for those seeking a relaxed drink away from Sairee’s bustle.
bars.localTip: Suggest guests come by 18:15 to secure a deck seat for sunset. It’s quieter earlier (daytime workers stop by). Quiet atmosphere – ideal for couples or solo reading. The menu includes creative cocktails with seasonal fruit. Near airport path; taxi to Haad Chao Phao area after (tuk-tuks only). Not suitable for dancing or loud parties. Check FB for theme nights (e.g. acoustic Wednesdays)
bars.bestKnownFor: Panoramic sunset vistas and expertly-crafted cocktails. It’s a favorite for those seeking a relaxed drink away from Sairee’s bustle
bars.signatureDrink: Specialty cocktails with tropical fruits (e.g. *Chilled Mule*, *Passion Spritz*) and SangSom Whiskey options
bars.signatureFood: Bar snacks (cheese plates, bruschetta) and a limited tapas menu
bars.atmosphere: Laid-back lounge with chillout music. Twilight garden ambiance
bars.musicStyle: Soft acoustic or chill electronic lounge. Quiet enough for conversation
bars.happyHour: Some drink specials at 17:00–19:00 (check social media)
bars.practicalInfo: Prime for sunset viewing – best arrive by 18:00. No kitchen (snacks only). The staff is multilingual. It can get busy at 19:00; no reservations. Diverse crowd (ages 20s–40s). Recommended for an early evening drink to start night out

bars.name: Sairee Cottage Pool Bar
bars.cardDescription: The Pool Bar at Sairee Cottage Resort is a popular swim-up bar on Sairee Beach. It offers high-quality imported spirits, craft beers and creative cocktails, plus the “best cold & creamy Guinness in Thailand”. The bar...
bars.about: The Pool Bar at Sairee Cottage Resort is a popular swim-up bar on Sairee Beach. It offers high-quality imported spirits, craft beers and creative cocktails, plus the “best cold & creamy Guinness in Thailand”. The bar sits partially in the pool itself, so guests can drink while wading. It’s famed for watching the sunset from the pool or deck
bars.recommendation: Choose Sairee Cottage Pool Bar when you are looking for being a poolside bar with top-shelf drinks and spectacular sunset views over the water. Notable for its whiskey selection and “the best Bloody Mary on the island”.
bars.localTip: Recommend arriving mid-afternoon to claim a swim-up seat. Music won’t impede conversation. The pool bar serves the resort, so do not expect restaurant service. Best open 17:00–19:00 for sunset swim. It gets quieter after 20:00 (pool drains). No smoking in pool. Small cover (100฿) sometimes collected from outsiders in high season (includes drink). Keep valuables with you (no lockers)
bars.bestKnownFor: Being a poolside bar with top-shelf drinks and spectacular sunset views over the water. Notable for its whiskey selection and “the best Bloody Mary on the island”
bars.signatureDrink: Bloody Mary (claimed as island’s best); also top-shelf cocktails like Mai Tai, Espresso Martini
bars.signatureFood: Light bar snacks (nachos, wings) – not a full kitchen. The focus is on drinks rather than food
bars.atmosphere: Fun but laid-back pool scene. Musical selection is chill by day (island reggae/lounge). The bar is mostly swing seats and stools in water
bars.musicStyle: Chill reggae/lounge music. Not loud EDM
bars.beachfront: Yes (in front of Sairee Cottage, open beach plus pool)
bars.familyFriendly: Adults preferred (pool, alcohol). Children only if under supervision
bars.seating: Outdoor (in-pool bar seats and poolside tables)
bars.hours: Daily noon–22:00. (Closes if resort closes; usually 15:00–22:00)
bars.happyHour: Informally on drinks (e.g. free tapas with certain cocktail orders)
nearby: adjacent to Sairee Cottage dive shop
bars.accessibility: Accessible via resort grounds. Enter through small gate; walk to pool. Must be 16+ to be in bar (as resort pool)
bars.parking: Scooters can park just outside resort gate
bars.practicalInfo: Guests must stay hydrated – free drinking water provided. Towels available in resort. No Wi-Fi (enjoy tech break). Friendly staff (Irish owner) pours strong drinks

bars.name: Queen’s Cabaret Koh Tao
bars.cardDescription: Queen’s Cabaret is the island’s only nightly transgender cabaret show, located just off Sairee Beach. It features a colourful stage revue with drag performers and dancers in dazzling costumes. Shows start at 21:30...
bars.about: Queen’s Cabaret is the island’s only nightly transgender cabaret show, located just off Sairee Beach. It features a colourful stage revue with drag performers and dancers in dazzling costumes. Shows start at 21:30 and last about 1.5 hours. It’s a lively, family-friendly theater setting with seating and spotlights
bars.recommendation: Choose Queen’s Cabaret Koh Tao when you are looking for entertaining ladyboy performance with music and dance numbers. Many guests cite it as a “must-see” local nightlife attraction.
bars.localTip: Tickets can be booked via Facebook DM or by phone; recommend booking at least one day ahead. Seats are general admission; earlier arrival secures front seats. Family-friendly but note there is no explicit cover of private parts (costumes can be skimpy). Popular with honeymooners and groups. Taxis/bikes can drop at Sairee road (no big parking); if late, return transport scarce (arrange in advance)
bars.bestKnownFor: Entertaining ladyboy performance with music and dance numbers. Many guests cite it as a “must-see” local nightlife attraction
bars.signatureDrink: Thai whiskey mixers (included free drink), Thai beer (Chang) on sale. Each ticket includes one free beverage
bars.signatureFood: Popcorn or peanuts (bar snacks). Full meals not served (eat beforehand)
bars.atmosphere: Showroom theater; fun, camp and interactive. The audience is encouraged to clap and sing along
bars.musicStyle: Pop and disco hits (live lip-sync/dance). Local Thai music as encore
bars.dancing: Audience participation possible, but no general dancing area
bars.seating: Indoor theater with rows of chairs
nearby: On street behind Sairee Beach (follow signs or ask taxi)
bars.accessibility: Step entry, theater seating; not wheelchair-friendly
bars.parking: N/A (no public parking; walkable from Sairee)
bars.practicalInfo: Seats 60; often sells out at showtime – arrive by 21:10. Ticket cost includes a drink coupon (beer or wine). Not recommended if hearing-impaired (Thai language announcements). The show runs till ~23:00. Credit cards not accepted
